create_pixelwise_head: create a PixelwiseTaskWithDPT head with custom hooks_idx and layer_dims for a CroCo backbone
setup_dpt_head: setup a PixelwiseTaskWithDPT head by calling setup with a CroCoNet to initialize the DPT adapter
forward_pixelwise_prediction: run forward pass on PixelwiseTaskWithDPT with feature tensor x and img_info dict containing width and height
configure_auto_hooks: configure PixelwiseTaskWithDPT to auto-select hooks_idx based on encoder-only or encoder-plus-decoder CroCoNet architecture
add_postprocess_head: create a PixelwiseTaskWithDPT head with a postprocess callable to transform DPT output before returning
